hook: Your private AI requests may be routed to ByteDance.

beats.say: A new investigation finds fingerprints showing several OpenRouter providers, including ones marketed as zero data retention, forward DeepSeek and GLM requests to ByteDance's Ark.
The clues include ByteDance style request IDs passed through from other providers, and ByteDance's canned refusal when you ask about censored topics like Tank Man.
Novita alone sent one hundred twenty to one hundred sixty billion tokens a day on these models, until it lost its zero retention label on November twentieth.
